tools/collect_sources.py: Windows/MSYS2 release verification needs the pacman public keyring, signed detached-signature members, MSYS2 epoch filenames, and makepkg's checksums for pinned Git snapshots.
tools/package_inventory.py: Windows bundles include byte-verified notices from matching MSYS2 source archives when the binary package ships no notice.
tools/release_gate.py: Keep the published Flatpak filename and also require the signed sources and the Linux portable bundle with its verified source provenance.
tools/flatpak_repo_files.py: The Flatpak repository links to the verified source archive shared by the Windows, Linux portable and Flatpak downloads.
